plugins.name: psx-trader-skill
plugins.description: 13 Claude skills for the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Find setups, read the news, time the entry, plan the exit, replay a trade 10,000 times, check the risk, size the order and get price alerts, for day or swing trades. Order tickets you place yourself: paper by default, never without your yes. Also a results analyst, an insider tracker, long-term signals for the shares you hold, and auto-run, which lets your Mac run the checks on a timer.
